requirements.requirement: Exact repository identity and a reproducible declared-dependency baseline
requirements.validation: Match remote/main SHA and tree; clean isolated install; run documented quality and simulation commands
requirements.negative_control: Reject wrong project or base SHA in Stage 0 contract

requirements.requirement: Every public capability claim has an evidence label, pointer, and limitation or corrected wording
requirements.validation: Audit README, docs/claims.yaml, architecture, runbooks, evidence, code, and cited CI
requirements.negative_control: Reject unsupported AWS_VERIFIED and missing evidence in claim registry

requirements.requirement: Explicit event and knowledge clock semantics, window boundaries, corrections, retractions, and deterministic ties
requirements.validation: Versioned temporal specification and hand-calculated fixtures against actual source contract
requirements.negative_control: Ambiguous same-time conflicting revisions and invalid availability clocks fail closed

requirements.requirement: No knowledge learned after a prediction cutoff influences that historical row
requirements.validation: Independent oracle and before/after late-correction counterexample
requirements.negative_control: Deliberately leaky event-time-only selection yields the wrong prior row

requirements.requirement: Revision and retraction selection is deterministic under input permutation and replay
requirements.validation: Differential small-history and property tests against the independent oracle
requirements.negative_control: Changed tie rule, duplicate conflict, or lost retraction is detected

requirements.requirement: Immutable definition and pinned input provenance reproduce training dataset content
requirements.validation: Two clean builds from one source snapshot/definition/code frontier compare canonical row and manifest digests
requirements.negative_control: Changed source snapshot or definition content cannot reuse the prior identity

requirements.requirement: Meaningful payment-risk features and offline history produce hand-checkable point-in-time training rows
requirements.validation: Fresh-checkout end-to-end demo and row-by-row independent oracle comparison
requirements.negative_control: A late correction cannot rewrite the earlier prediction vector

requirements.requirement: Candidates stay isolated and active generation changes through guarded compare-and-swap
requirements.validation: Persistent local state, validation, reader pinning, and two-publisher race
requirements.negative_control: Incomplete candidate and stale publisher cannot become active

requirements.requirement: Partial failure, duplicate dispatch, retry, and rollback retain a valid active generation
requirements.validation: Fault-injection matrix and process-restart recovery on persistent local store
requirements.negative_control: Conflicting retry or stale rollback fails without clobbering current pointer

requirements.requirement: Each stage's claims and artifacts bind to exact-head PR checks and independently verified merged main
requirements.validation: Stage receipts, job-level CI, recorded merge provenance, and merged-main rerun; record whether branch protection was active at merge
requirements.negative_control: Moved head or changed artifact digest invalidates the prior receipt
